description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiora of Fire and Ashes, adding {C}{C}.
When Kiora of Fire and Ashes dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Kiora of Fire and Ashes from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Kiora of Fire and Ashes enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
